title: Grateful Dead Live at Stanley Theatre on 1972-09-26

ai_review.summary: Solid soundboard capture of a high‑energy show with a smoking He's Gone and standout Cold Rain, though the bright ’72 PA leaves the mix a bit thin.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its fine ensemble playing, highlighted by an amazing version of He’s Gone, one of the best Cold Rain & Snow renditions of the year, and an impressive Sugar Magnolia. Recording-wise the soundboard is clear but the notoriously squeaky‑clean ’72 PA makes tuning feel thin at times, giving the tape a good but not pristine quality.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical performance with several standout songs outweighs minor recording issues; consistent positive comments across most reviews give a solid rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear soundboard source but the 1972 PA is overly bright and squeaky‑clean, making instrument tuning feel thin; no major dropouts reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows well with strong ensemble playing throughout, highlighted by a tight He’s Gone tease and solid jams.

band_member_comments.Bob: Unusual chord tease at the start of He's Gone, possibly zonked or a playful tease.
